mapper.select: SELECT * FROM salary_contract WHERE sabun = #{sabun} AND signed_at IS NULL AND ( (end_date IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date) OR (end_date IS NULL AND CURDATE() >= start_date) ) ORDER BY start_date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM salary_contract WHERE sabun = #{sabun} AND signed_at IS NOT NULL AND ( (end_date IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date) OR (end_date IS NULL AND CURDATE() >= start_date) ) ORDER BY start_date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: insert into salary_contract( sabun, base_salary, meal_allowance, start_date, end_date ) values( #{sabun}, #{base_salary}, #{meal_allowance}, #{start_date}, #{end_date, jdbcType=DATE} )
mapper.select: select * from salary_ledger where sabun = #{sabun} and status = '완료' and pay_ym = #{ym}

select l.salary_id, l.pay_ym, l.sabun, s.saname, d.dname, l.base_pay, l.overtime_pay, l.meal_pay, l.national_pension, l.health_insurance, l.long_term_care, l.employment_insurance, l.income_tax, l.local_income_tax, l.net_pay, l.status, l.created_at from salary_ledger l join sawon s on s.sabun = l.sabun join dept d on s.deptno = d.deptno where l.pay_ym = #{ym} and l.status = '대기' order by sabun
mapper.update: update salary_ledger set status = '완료' where salary_id = #{salary_id}
mapper.select: select count(case when signed_at is null then 1 end) as pendingCount, count(case when timestampdiff(year, start_date, curdate()) >= 1 and signed_at is not null then 1 end) as renewalCount from salary_contract

select s.sabun, s.saname, d.dname, sc.start_date, sc.end_date, sc.signed_at, sc.contract_id from sawon s inner join dept d on s.deptno = d.deptno left join salary_contract sc on s.sabun = sc.sabun
and s.deptno = #{deptno}
and s.saname like concat('%', #{saname}, '%')
AND sc.signed_at IS NULL and sc.contract_id is not null
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, sc.start_date, CURDATE()) >= 1 AND sc.signed_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.deptno ASC, s.sabun ASC
ORDER BY s.sabun ASC

select s.sabun, s.saname, d.dname, sc.base_salary, sc.meal_allowance, date_format(sc.start_date, '%y-%m-%d') as start_date, date_format(sc.end_date, '%y-%m-%d') as end_date, date_format(sc.signed_at, '%y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as signed_at from sawon s inner join dept d on s.deptno = d.deptno left join salary_contract sc on s.sabun = sc.sabun where sc.contract_id = #{contract_id}
select count(sabun) from salary_closed_attendance where closed_ym = #{ym} and status = '완료'
select sc.*, d.dname, s.saname from salary_closed_attendance sc join sawon s on sc.sabun = s.sabun join dept d on s.deptno = d.deptno where closed_ym = #{ym} and status = '완료'
